units.rawText: That's something only heroes get to do, after all. <size=24>I've wanted to do that for ages...</size>

units.rawText: Can't believe you're still alive... You insects cling to life so tenaciously.

units.rawText: Seems like this "gear" is... insufficient.

units.rawText: I knew it. I knew your capabilities couldn't have risen so much all out of nowhere. That purple light of yours comes from requisitioning operands, doesn't it?

units.rawText: Requisitioning operands? So you're saying she's secretly transferring operands from somewhere to herself?
units.displayText: Requisitioning operands? So you're saying she's secretly transferring operands from somewhere to herself?

spans.text: Requisitioning operands? So you're saying she's secretly transferring operands from somewhere to herself?

units.rawText: Hmph... I hate perceptive insects.

units.rawText: Everyone, careful! She's coming around for another one!
units.displayText: Everyone, careful! She's coming around for another one!

units.rawText: Persicaria, cover Croque! Antonina and I will try to pin her down!

units.rawText: Tch, roger that!
units.displayText: Tch, roger that!

units.rawText: Coordinate like always! It takes time for her to requisition operands, so we're not out of this yet!

units.rawText: Looking back, we see Croque stumble out of a scorched hunk of metal. We can vaguely make out the shape of Dirac's head, its blue-green eyes now dull and lifeless.
